nodes.label: Phase 2 Prompt 5C: Connect Search screen to Discogs API
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase2 - Prompt 5C: Connect Search screen to Discogs API.md
nodes.rationale: Replaces fake local search results with real Discogs data; deliberately defers debounce and detail navigation to keep the slice small and the app runnable at every step.

nodes.label: Discogs API Client
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase2 - Prompt 5C: Connect Search screen to Discogs API.md
nodes.rationale: Lives in the infrastructure layer; methods receive the user token as input but never store or log it, and must detect Discogs rate-limit responses.

nodes.label: Secure Token Storage
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase2 - Prompt 5C: Connect Search screen to Discogs API.md
nodes.rationale: Token is loaded just before API calls; screens show a friendly connect-token-in-Settings message when absent, and the token is never displayed or logged.
